resources.string: If the app froze, Bluetooth dropped or the screen reset, send the system logs so the developer can find the cause. Nothing is collected or sent until you confirm.

The following will be collected and sent to your account, where only the developer can read it:

• Recent system crash, freeze and restart records (including Bluetooth and camera services)
• MapControl's last exit reasons
• Bluetooth status
• The recent system log
• Current state of permissions, services and displays
• MapControl's event log (install, permission and service events)

Phone numbers, email addresses, Bluetooth addresses, device names and coordinates are masked before sending. Logs are deleted after 30 days. The event log stays on this device (at most ~400 KB) and is shared only when you send it.

Removes duplicate MapControl icons from the car\'s home screen. The car\'s home screen restarts for a moment; system icons and their positions stay.

Stops the iFlytek voice assistant from crashing and restarting in a loop at startup. Only its faulty server address (flamesdev.iflytekauto.cn) is blocked, inside the car; no traffic leaves the car. A VPN key icon may appear in the status bar.
Off: with Wi-Fi on, the iFlytek voice assistant may crash and restart repeatedly at startup.
